term: global parthood, actual fusion and fixed-whole actuality
resolution: ActualPartsExistAt is downward: an actual whole has actual parts. Actual-family fusion requires all selected members actual; leastness places their fusion below the world object. Neither says that one actual part actualizes the fixed global whole. Greatestness in the candidate roster differs from actuality, and ∀world∃greatest-actual-whole differs from ∃whole∀world-actual. NecessaryAt retains the same literal individual across accessible worlds; there is no counterpart or temporal identity substitution. The empty cause relation is not a claim of satisfying causal availability. Existing actual-fusion necessity theorems keep their additional causal inputs.
